title: Project Delivery Grant Instance Overlays Manifest
description: Optional project-level declared delivery-grant destination overlays (.loxtep/delivery-grant-instance-overlays.json). Prefer destination_overlays[] on grant entities; use this manifest to declare or override destinations without editing every grant file. Prefer environment_key over instance UUIDs. grant_id is the subscriber id. Deploy upserts delivery_grant_instance_overlays from the matching declaration (fail closed — no silent stage→prod copy).

grant_id.description: Delivery grant id. Deploy upserts this as data_product_subscriber_id.

data_product_id.description: Optional extra identity. Does not replace grant_id.

connection_id.description: Optional extra identity. Does not replace grant_id.

environment_key.description: Logical environment (stage, prod, dev, …). Preferred over hard-coded instance UUIDs in git.

instance_id.description: Optional explicit instance pin (same-env geo). When set, matches that instance before environment_key.

destination_config.description: Non-empty destination applied for this env or instance. An empty object is refused.
